recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有大量中至大型母細胞，染色質細緻、核形不規則，細胞質灰藍色、無顆粒，部分於細胞膜下可見小空泡或偽足樣突起；切片瀰漫浸潤，免疫染色 CD56、CD123、CD4、TCL1 共同陽性，符合母細胞性漿細胞樣樹突細胞腫瘤（BPDCN）。
features: Bone marrow aspirate: numerous medium-to-large blasts with high N:C ratio, irregular to indented nuclei, fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Blast cytoplasm moderate, grey-blue and agranular, some with small peripheral vacuoles or tail-like cytoplasmic projections (arrows)
Residual maturing granulocytes, erythroid precursors and small lymphocytes admixed
Core biopsy: hypercellular marrow for age with interstitial-to-diffuse sheets of blasts between fat; high power shows irregular, folded nuclei with fine chromatin and frequent mitoses
IHC: blasts coexpress CD56, CD123, CD4 and TCL1, with a CD123/TCL1-negative residual lymphoid aggregate
describe_en: The bone marrow aspirate shows numerous medium-to-large blasts with irregular or indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli, and moderate agranular grey-blue cytoplasm, some with small cytoplasmic vacuoles or tail-like projections; residual trilineage elements are present. The core biopsy is hypercellular with interstitial and sheet-like infiltration by atypical cells with folded nuclei, fine chromatin, and frequent mitotic figures. By immunohistochemistry the neoplastic cells coexpress CD56, CD123, CD4, and TCL1, while a residual lymphoid aggregate is negative for CD123 and TCL1. Findings are consistent with involvement by blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation (CD4+/CD56+)
ddx.vs: Monocytic AML can express CD4 and CD56 but usually shows MPO/lysozyme/CD14/CD11c and lacks the coexpression of bright CD123, TCL1 and CD303 seen here.

ddx.dx: AML with increased mature plasmacytoid dendritic cells (pDC-AML)
ddx.vs: In pDC-AML the pDCs are CD34-negative, CD56-negative mature-appearing cells accompanying a separate CD34+ myeloid blast population, whereas here the CD56+ CD123+ TCL1+ blasts themselves constitute the neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma or NK-lymphoblastic leukemia
ddx.vs: NK neoplasms are CD56-positive but negative for CD123, TCL1 and CD4, and NK/T-cell lymphoma is EBER-positive.
Lymphoblastic leukemias express TdT with cytoplasmic CD3 or CD19/PAX5 and lack the CD4/CD56/CD123/TCL1 plasmacytoid dendritic cell profile.

stain: Wright-Giemsa; H&E; IHC: CD56, CD123, CD4, TCL1
captions: Bone marrow aspirate: numerous blasts with agranular grey-blue cytoplasm among residual hematopoietic cells (arrow)
Bone marrow aspirate, high power: blast with fine chromatin and grey-blue cytoplasm (arrow)
Core biopsy H&E, low power: hypercellular marrow with interstitial blast infiltration
Core biopsy H&E, high power: sheets of blasts with irregular folded nuclei and mitoses
IHC: tumor cells positive for CD56, CD123, CD4 and TCL1
